description: Connect HyNote to ChatGPT to search and list notes in your authenticated HyNote workspace, open note previews, and retrieve readable note content for analysis. You can also create new text notes after granting write access. The plugin cannot edit or delete existing notes. PDF and image notes may return only an available snippet.

defaultPrompt: Create a HyNote text note titled "Ideas" with the content "Review the launch plan on Friday."
